And as all Spirits and Angels are affections, it is evident that the universal Heaven is the love of all affections of good, and the derivative wisdom of all perceptions of truth. DP 196.
So also can one Spirit be infilled by another, even until he knows not but that he is the other.
They still do the evils in their spirit: for it is the spirit of man which thinks and wills.

As it is the spirit of man which wills and understands... it follows that this external and internal of thought are the external and internal of the spirit of man. What the body does is only an effect from the internal and external of his spirit; for the body is only obedience.

For the internal of man's thought, or his internal man, is his spirit itself; and in it are things more infinite and innumerable than there are in his body; for the spirit of man is man in his own form; and all things of it correspond to all things of man in his body. DP 145:3.

So neither does man know how the Lord operates into all things of his mind or soul, that is, into all things of his spirit... But still the Lord cannot purify man from any concupiscence... in his spirit or internal man so long as the man keeps the external closed... by evils.
Hence it is that the spirit of man is a man in all its form...
For the mind of man is his spirit; and, according to the conjunction with the Lord, it is an Angel; and the body is obedience.
Visions induced by enthusiastic Spirits, and visionary ones...
a. 2. Speech with the dead would produce an effect like that of miracles... But this happens only when the Spirits bring in something dogmatic of religion, which is never done by any good Spirit...
Still, speech with Spirits is possible, but rarely with Angels. (Continued. See Speak.) They never teach.
Like one with his breath held.
Hence it is that no Angel or Spirit was created immediately; but all were first born men.
The spirit (of an infernal) is itself an evil... DP 296:9. It is inhaled with full breath.
Man's mind is his spirit which lives after death, (which) is in the whole form in which is Heaven, or Hell: there is no difference, except that one is the greatest, and the other the least...
For man as to his spirit is in the Spiritual World, and in some Society there, (Continued. See Society.) DP 317.

One Spirit can infuse his thoughts and affections into another Spirit, and the latter know no otherwise than that what is infused is of his Own thought and affection. This is called thinking from another, and thinking in another. I have seen it a thousand times, and have done it a hundred; and yet the appearance of distance was great. But as soon as they knew it was another... they were indignant, and averted themselves... Evil Spirits have often injected into my thought evils and falsities... and I have inquired who injected them... and they were at a great distance from me.
It is the mind or spirit which (sensates in the body)... But still the mind or spirit of man does not sensate of itself, but from the Lord.
Those instructed by influx what to believe and do, are not instructed by the Lord, nor by any Angel; but by some enthusiastic Spirit, Quaker, or Moravian, and are led astray.
By this, spirit comes into his civil and moral things, and they live; otherwise, there is no spirit in them...
He then becomes a Spirit in human form: his mind is that Spirit.
The spirit of man cannot be anywhere else than in the delight of his life, because this makes its life, and even its very respiration and the pulsation of its heart. It is otherwise (here).
The seven spirits () = all in Divine truth; in the abstract sense, the Divine Truth itself. ( = the Divine in Heaven. AE 24.) AR 155. AE 183. AR 237. AR 272. AE 318.
I was in the spirit () = a spiritual state. Explained, Illustrated. AR 228. AR 722. ( = a spiritual state with revelation. AE 53, Explained.) AE 266.
Of water and the spirit = through truths, and a life according to them.
What the spirit saith unto the churches () = what the Divine truth of the Word teaches those who will be of the New Church. AR 118, etc. AE 108.
Angels Spirits () = those in truths; angels ministers, those in goods.
I saw a company of Spirits on their knees...
For every man is conjoined with Spirits as to the affections, insomuch that they make a one.
The spirit of life from God () = spiritual life. ( = Divine truth proceeding. AE 665.)
The conjunction of man with Spirits in like affection and derivative thoughts is such that if the copula were loosed for a single moment the man would fall down dead.
To give spirit to the image of the beast () = to confirm it from the Word. ( = something of spiritual life by conjunction with the Word. AE 831.)
Yea, saith the spirit () = that the Divine truth of the Word teaches. ( = asseveration that it is true. For the spirit, like angel = truth from the Lord. AE 900.)
Three unclean spirits like frogs () = mere ratiocinations and cupidities of falsifying truths. By spirits are here signified the like as by demons. ( = falsities of evil from Hell. AE 1000.)
The hold of every unclean spirit () = evils of will and thence of act... By spirit is signified everything which is of affection or will, and thence of deed. See AE 1099.
The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy () = that it is the whole of the Word and of doctrine thence.
He carried me away in the spirit () = that he was translated.
An Angel was sent to John in order that he might be kept in a state of the spirit... No one can come into this state... except through Angels who are closely adjoined to the man. Explained.
When the prophets spoke the Word, they were not in the spirit, but in the body... But when they were in the other state, they say that they were in the spirit. Illustrated.
The spirit and the bride say. Come () = that Heaven and the Church long for the advent of the Lord, The spirit = Heaven... because the angelic Spirits are meant from whom is the New Heaven.
I was in the spirit, and in this stood on a hill...
The third said... When I came into my own light and heat, my spirit and my heart returned to me.
As to the affections and thoughts of his mind, man is in the midst of Angels and Spirits, and is so consociated with them that he cannot be divorced from them without dying.
That Angels and Spirits are men, may be evident from those seen by Abraham, etc... the eyes of whose spirits were then opened...
Under Spiritual, see this reference.
The interior man, which is the same as the spirit which lives after death, is the form of his own love...
It is impossible for any Angel of Heaven to descend, or for any Spirit of Hell to ascend, and speak with any man, except those who have the interiors of their spirit opened by the Lord...
For love is properly of the spirit of man, and is of the body from the spirit; and after death man becomes a Spirit, and so carries his love with him. CL 47.
The externals are properly of the body; and the internals are properly of the spirit.
When conjugial love becomes of the spirit...
There were many Spirits around me...
The ardour proper to the body is not yet mitigated by the love of the spirit.
Spiritual purification compared to that of natural spirits, which is called defecation, etc... And wisdom purified compared to alcohol, which is spirit most highly rectified.

This is not chastity, unless there is abstinence in the spirit. The spirit of man, by which is here meant his mind as to the affections and thoughts, makes what is chaste and unchaste. (Continued. See Body.)
They still commit adulteries in the spirit. TCR 316:2.
The internal form of man, which is that of his spirit (is continually changing). Explained.
The soul and the mind are the man; for both make the spirit which lives after death.
For the spirit, after it has been separated from the body, comes into full freedom of acting according to its affections and thoughts.
As soon as he comes into company, he inverts his spirit...

They who indulge their imagination too much... almost separate their spirit from connection with the body... Into this delirium is every man let after death who has abstracted his spirit from the body...

Angels and Spirits have internal and external affections equally with men; (but) both are with them reduced into correspondence... They have internal and external affections, because they have a mind and a body...
Thus his spirit is convinced; and the things in which the spirit is convinced are allotted a place above those which enter from (mere) authority.
Consent initiates the daughter's spirit into love; but extorted consent does not initiate the spirit, although it may the body...
By betrothing... there is effected a marriage of the spirit before one of the body.
All things done by man in the body inflow from his spirit...
I was in the spirit, that is, in a state like that in which are the men of the Spiritual World, who are called Spirits and Angels.
You are called Spirits and Angels; and in the world you believed that Spirits and Angels are like winds... but now you clearly see that you are truly men...
(With those who had lived in love truly conjugial) the spirit of a deceased partner dwells constantly with the spirit of the (other)...
I became in the spirit, and in the spirit went out to them...
When I let my spirit into the body, you no longer saw me; but when I let it out of the body, you saw me.
(The words of spiritual language are not understood by Spirits themselves when they are with men. Shown by experiment.)
(Spirits) are in principles (or beginnings) and thus in singulars; but (men) are in principiates and composites; (the former) are in particulars; (the latter) in generals...
A Spirit thinks himself to be what the garment he wears indicates.
The delights of scortatory love are of the flesh even in the spirit; but those of conjugial love begin in the spirit, and are of the spirit even in the flesh. Explained.
For the spirit, and not the flesh, feels the things which happen in the flesh. (So with the other senses.)
A Spirit with a torch rose up...
Spirits and Angels supposed to be pneumata... Yet they are substantial men, and live together like men... upon spaces and in times, which are determined according to the states of their minds.
An Angel or Spirit can in a moment become present to another, provided he comes into a like affection and thought. Example(s).
As to his spirit (such a man) is actually in Heaven with the Angels.
I became in the spirit.
Such is the reciprocal conjunction of the soul and the body, and of the spirit with the organs of the body.
A Spirit seen falling from Heaven like a thunderbolt. Explained.

The souls and minds of the good are connected with the souls and minds of Angels; and those of the evil, with the souls and minds of infernal Spirits. They have such a union, that if they were removed from man, he would fall down dead; and neither could Angels and Spirits subsist if men were withdrawn from under them.

I said, I know that all [the Spirits] here are consociated with their like in the natural world; tell me... with whom you are consociated. He replied, in a grave tone, ... With a famous man, a leader... in the Church... He lives near Luther's tomb... I said. Inspire your famous man with this... He replied,I cannot, because he and I, as to this matter, make almost one mind; but he does not understand the things which I say, while I clearly understand all he says. For the Spiritual World enters into the natural world, and perceives the thoughts of men there; but not the reverse. This is the state of the consociation of Spirits and men.

(Another Spirit said), I, too, am consociated with a man in your world, who is in a place of high honour. This I know, because I speak from him, as he does from me... He resides at Gottenburg; and I once thought from him that your doctrine savours of Mohammedanism... I turned to the latter consociated Spirit, and said, Tell him at Gottenburg, if you can, to read ().
A new heart = the will of good; a new spirit = the understanding of truth. Illustrated.
Water = truth in the external man; spirit () = truth from good in the internal man.
The spirit of prophecy () = the truth of doctrine from the Word.
That a man's spirit is his mind, and whatever proceeds from it. General article.

As man's spirit thinks from the understanding, and acts from the will; and as the body... thinks and acts from the spirit, it follows that by man's spirit is meant his intelligence and affection of love, and whatever proceeds and operates from them.
That the spirit of man = such things as are of the mind. Illustrated.

As the spirit means the mind, to be in the spirit means a state of the mind separate from the body... The prophets were then in a state such as is that of Spirits and Angels... In this state, the spirit of man... can be transferred from place to place, the body remaining in its own place. This is the state in which I have been for 26 years, with this difference: that I have been in the spirit and at the same time in the body; and only sometimes out of the body. That (the prophets) were in this state. Illustrated.
The way from this world seen crowded with Spirits. Explained.
The boreal Spirits. Described.
When God is thought to be a Spirit, and a Spirit is thought to be ether...
Under Simple, see this reference.

I fear that (Arianism and Socinianism) lie concealed at this day in the general spirit of the men of the Church... (The reason is that) there is with every man a consociate Spirit; for without this man cannot think... and every man summons to himself a Spirit similar to the affection of his will and the derivative perception of his understanding; (either an Angel from Heaven, or a Spirit from Hell). Explained.
These (four) periods of life are those of man's spirit, and not likewise of his body. Explained.

The internal man is in the Spiritual World... Man was so created that he can be associated with Spirits and Angels in their World, and thereby think analytically... As the internal man is in company with Spirits and Angels in their World... it is evident that man can be consociated with Spirits of Hell, and also with Angels of Heaven... The internal man is his spirit, which acts by the external.

The spirit of man also is created from finite things. What is the spirit of man but a receptacle of the life of the mind? The finite things from which it is, are spiritual substances which... are also brought into our earth, and stored up therein...

The mind of man is his spirit which lives after death; and the spirit of man is constantly in company with its like in the Spiritual World; and, through the material body with which it is encompassed, his spirit is with men in the natural world. The reason man does not know that as to his mind he is in the midst of Spirits, is that the Spirits with whom he is in company... think and speak spiritually; Whereas the spirit of man... thinks and speaks naturally... But when the spirit of man is in society with Spirits... he is also in spiritual thought and speech with them, for... he communicates with Spirits by his interiors, but with men by his exteriors. By this communication, man perceives Things, and thinks of them analytically...
In the middle of this interspace is every man as to his spirit. TCR 476:2. TCR 497:3.
For the life of the spirit of man consists in his free will in spiritual things.
The will and understanding constitute man's spirit which lives after death...
I was in the interior spiritual sight in which are the Angels of the higher Heaven, and I saw two spirits (one of whom was conjoined with Heaven, and the other with Hell). Described.
The Reformed, as to their spirits, are among their like, who introduce such things into their ideas.
(The Angels say to the novitiates) You are now Spirits, in a substantial body, and the spirit is your internal man. It is this in you which thinks and wills...
The Angels said to them, You will... enter into the internal in which your spirit is now.
Every love breathes out delight proximately into the spirit...
A new spirit = a new understanding.
Men, Angels, and spirits know not of the conjunction between them, because man... is in a natural state, and an Angel and a Spirit are in a spiritual one.
Every Angel sees the Lord in front of him... It is the same with a man... as to the sight of his spirit; but this state of his spirit is not known...
The eyes of the spirit cannot be opened with anyone who is in evils and falsities.
Emanuel Swedenborg was filled with the Lord's Spirit...
For the mind of man is his spirit, or the posthumous man...
These are called heavenly Spirits, higher Spirits, also Angels of God...
The world... subject to Spirits who had become natural and infra-celestial. Their prince, etc.
Lives or essences which are called heavenly Spirits and Angels.
In the heavenly sphere, there are other Spirits and Genii than the celestial and truly spiritual ones... These Spirits are malignant...
Men are ruled through Spirits...
Heavenly Spirits have so ruled the actions of my whole body...
Spirits know no otherwise than that they themselves are the man...
How Spirits operate into men.
Tricks of Spirits.
Spirits do not know what they are going to say until they have said it.
Evil Spirits are not deliberately deceitful, but weave their poisonous wiles as it were unknowingly; thus their nature acts. SE 253. SE 1043.
How evil Spirits can personate others.
Spirits induce dreams; and, when man sleeps, they dream in like manner. SE 664. SE 1882. SE 2436.

Spirits speak freely with man if he does not reflect upon the nature of it. They cannot bear that Spirits coming from some other place should speak with the man. One knows not of the presence of another. When they are not spoken to, they know no otherwise than that they are the man.
It displeases Spirits that man should answer and explore their genius, and should rule them. SE 3563.
(Index, under Memoria). Spirits and Angels have their sensuous memory from the man with whom they are.
The Spirits with a man are as the man; learned with the learned, stupid with the stupid...

There are many Spirits around a man, of whom one does not know another. Each thinks himself the man. They come; go away; but whence, to whom, and from whom, they know not. They think they shall always remain there.
On the general sphere of Spirits.
All the rest are called Spirits.
On the perturbation of the understanding by the dissension of Spirits.
When I was thinking in my ordinary state, the Spirits believed it was they who were thinking; but those more remote believed this less and less...
With a man who thinks inwardly there are many Spirits present; but very few with one who thinks externally.
On the state of the Spirits with man when he is in his ordinary state.
But when I reflected upon the Spirits, they returned to themselves, and perceived that they were... separate from the man.
There are many states of Spirits. (Two described.)
For Genii and Spirits are classified...
Each Genius and Spirit has his own sphere of activity...
On the food and drink of Spirits.
On Spirits of various kinds.
When a man indulges in external things, he is removed from the manifest company of Angels, and is ruled by Spirits, and these by Angels...
On Spirits when separated and conjoined... Separate Spirits speak as it were from themselves. Explained.
On Angels and Spirits in general. Angels, evil Spirits, and intermediate Spirits.
Spirits do not always perceive what is thought by the man; but only that which agrees with their own states.
On the species of representations among Spirits.
All Spirits and Angels act and speak from others who are more interior. Explained. SE 195.
On the operation of Spirits and Angels in connection with human thoughts.
On the state of Spirits and Angels in perceiving the things of the body and the world.
The inmost and more interior Angels... said they knew nothing of what I was doing, as the nearest Spirits did...

On the general state of Spirits with men. - The Spirits with men do not speak or reflect to them; not that they suppose themselves to be those men with whom they are, but only that they are men... For every Spirit supposes himself to be a man... having ears, eyes, and senses such as men have... SE 296. SE 355. SE 481.
Spirits can be present, and speak with me, and perceive my thoughts, and yet see nothing of what I do.
On the fear felt by Spirits who are still free.
That myriads of Spirits and Angels concur to one human thought...
On the quickness with which Spirits learn.
A Society of Spirits of whom some are in the head of man, and some outside it. Described.
That the Spirits who are sent to a man suppose themselves to be the man to whom they come... They can put on everything of the man in a moment. SE 819. SE 1938. SE 2401.
(Spirits personated Abraham, Jacob, etc. to me. Explained.) SE 890.
Souls and Spirits seem to be transported from one place to another, sometimes with the velocity of lightning. Explained.
On the form of Spirits... They seem to themselves to wear garments.
It is wonderful that Souls and Spirits have senses exactly as in the body...
On the adroitness of Spirits in inventing things, like the truth.
That Spirits are signified by the wind... Spirits have often come to me with wind, which... moved papers, etc. SE 2392.
On the speech of Spirits. That Spirits Know each other...
Spirits are far more clever than men: how they prove the quality of other Spirits by leading them ta speak.
On Spirits speaking to men in Jupiter. SE 539. SE 541. SE 543. SE 544. SE 545. SE 570. SE 572.

On the communication of Spirits with man. Spirits, while with man, stand at his back, supposing that they are altogether men; and, if permitted, they could, through a man who speaks with them, but not through others, be completely in the life of the world, so as to communicate their thoughts by words through another man, and even by letters; for they have often directed my hand when writing... and, if permitted, they could write in their own style... but this is not permitted.

On Spirits properly so called, who are not Genii, but speaking Spirits... They want to be called intelligences, or knowledges; and suppose that they alone know, and rule, all things. In every degree there are such Spirits... When any object occurs... they at once suppose that they know what it is... and say it is this, or that, and describe it as if they knew all about it. Thus one after another describes it in a different way... And they at once persuade themselves that it is so... They also love to lead me while I am writing.
That man is ruled through Spirits and Angels...
On Spirits who lie concealed.
On the dreams of Spirits.
On the superior excellence of the faculties of Souls or Spirits. SE 2548, Explained.
Each Spirit has his own instinct of life. Explained.

When I have gone through the streets... and did not reflect upon the Spirits around me... they have told me that they have seen or heard nothing, but had been intent on the thought of my mind. Upon whatever Spirit I reflected, he was as it were excited... From this I could conclude that the Spirits in a man in whom the interiors have not been opened towards the Lord through faith, cannot speak to the man, nor see through his eyes; and that they enjoy only the memory and reasoning of the man...
Spirits remain without any reflection, and therefore know not but that they are men, and in the world, as before; and therefore they remain in their phantasies ... SE 736.
On the sleep of Spirits.
On the state of Spirits immediately after death. General article.
On the amazement of Spirits who had not believed in the life after death.
How Spirits can excite from man's memory the things which are in accordance with themselves.
Spirits can as it were read what is in man's memory. SE 1077.
That the appetite of eating, etc., can be induced upon Spirits. SE 1563. SE 2024.
That Spirits are instructed by means of man.
That man is quite unaware that he is led by Spirits, and through Spirits.
One Spirit is led by others, and, successively, by others... yet the Spirit is not aware of it...
So a Spirit can be led by a man while he is a Spirit...
Spirits are to be instructed according to... their faith in their lifetime.
Spirits sometimes suddenly vanish when they hear what they do not perceive.
The memory of Spirits. Explained.
On the Spirits who relate to the external ligaments.
On the communication of man's ideas with Spirits.
On Spirits who know no otherwise than that they are the Souls of others.
How Spirits communicate their thoughts to each other.
All Spirits as it were hunger and thirst to know...
Hence Spirits have so many privileges above men...
How filthy loves are manifested with some Spirits in the Heaven of Spirits.
Spirits whom I opined to be good, because they were in the company of the good...
The province which conveys the spirit...
A man can lead Spirits, and even Angels, to be of the same opinion...
So that the Spirits could not speak with me... Spirits cannot speak with a man who is devoted to worldly and corporeal cares.
The Spirits adjoined to a man are such as his phantasies are.
On Spirits within a triangular space.
On the multitude of Spirits who concur to a single action of man.

Each Spirit was the Subject of the representations of other like Spirits, so that they are never alone, but are the centres of the action of many; and therefore each Spirit is a cohort; so that there are as many centres as there are Spirits.

A deceitful Spirit who prayed to be liberated, and was admitted among the good. He restrained himself in order to remain there, but could not do so long. He was sent back to his former associates, who cast him down. He was let down to the Lower Earth, and began to dig a pit, and was discovered to be a poisoner. His punishment. SE 1269. SE 1288. SE 1296. SE 1299. (AC 817.)
The ideas of Spirits fall into the words of any language...
Spirits suppose they speak with me with their lips. Explained.

a. Vastation of a very self-confident Spirit. Described. (He had been of such a character for 17 centuries. SE 1377.) (Although he despised me, he desired to mix himself up with the things I have written. SE 1389.) (A female Spirit of this character. SE 1410-1414.)
That I was led by Spirits through ways, and streets, in gyres...
No Spirit or Angel can think anything which all near cannot understanding and perceive...
No Spirit can ever be quite alone...
When I had been writing, a Spirit thanked me for having helped him to write: he thought that he was I... Such are the cooperations of Spirits with man.
The Spirits of the small cutaneous glands. Described.

They assumed that a Spirit can enter into the body of a man, and so live corporeally... from the fact that a Spirit with a man supposes that he is the man... for, as the Spirit then thinks, apprehends, and wills in like manner with the man, and the acts follow, he supposes that he is the man. But this does not last long...
It is impossible for a Spirit to pass into a man's body, and live in it. Explained. SE 1750.
That the qualities of Spirits can be at once Known by those who are interior.
Spirits can be carried as it were out of themselves and see themselves as they really are.
That it is common and proper to man to speak with Spirits and Angels. SE 2541.
That when a Spirit is taken up into Heaven, he is as it were taken away from Spirits.
They spoke with me through Spirits...

That Spirits lie. - When Spirits begin to speak to man, he must beware of believing them; for they will say almost anything. Described... Therefore the state of speaking with Spirits in this Earth is very dangerous unless one is in true faith. They induce so strong a persuasion that it is the Lord Himself who is speaking, and commanding, that the man cannot but believe and obey.
That the things I have learned from... speaking with Spirits and Angels are from the Lord alone.
Thus have I been instructed; by no Spirit, or Angel... (TCR 779.)
A Spirit is sent to prepare the way for the coming of Angels to a man.
Spirits who are entirely unwilling to have been in the body. Described. SE 1684.
On an indeterminate state of Spirits. SE 1707, Explained.
Spirits have often charged me with having no life...
The notion that Spirits are devoid of senses, refuted.
Spirits through whom others speak... (They are very numerous SE 1722.) (Most of them are women. SE 1726.)
All Spirits and Angels... may be known from the Lord's prayer...
Genii are the meninx; Spirits are the fibres...
On the entrance of Spirits into the other life.
Then Spirits keep his mind fixed on...
On the impression with Spirits that their bodies are alive.
That Spirits are persuaded of things of which the man with whom they are is persuaded. SE 1853.
If Balaam had cursed the Israelites, some Spirits would have been so persuaded that they would have excited many crews against them.
The malevolence of Spirits in not only inducing thoughts and speech on man, but also the answer...
These Spirits... deprive the blood of its liquids and spirits.
Such Spirits seat themselves in the mind, as if their thought were the interior thought of the man, so that the man cannot know that such Spirits are present...
That Spirits know no otherwise than that they are the man.
That Spirits are persuaded from externals concerning internals.
Whatever is in the phantasy of the man comes into that of the Spirits. Example(s).
So when Aaron washed, etc., the Spirits believed he was holy.
On the heat of Spirits and Angels.
That Spirits persistently burn to have man subject to them.
On the spheres of Spirits.
That little credit is to be given to Spirits speaking.

a. By reflections, Spirits saw through me... As men do not believe that they are ruled through Spirits, such a reflection cannot be given them; and therefore Spirits do not see through man, but only know from his interiors. (With me) Spirits could see the several objects in the world, and those in the imagination, and those in the thought. While the mind is thus open towards Heaven, there is a certain continuous reflection, and thus a communication of the Spirits with the man, and they know thence that they are not the men with whom they are. SE 2247.
(The influence Spirits have over the will, as exemplified in the ease or difficulty felt in walking.)

That Spirits are excited by a man who are of like quality and affection with himself. - Man's states change every moment; (but) into whatever state a man comes. Spirits with whom a like passion had been dominant in their lifetime, correspond and cooperate; thus not the same ones, but very many, and they all suppose themselves to be the man...

On the Spirits who are with men. - The Spirits with me have been astounded that they were thus with man, and, with me, exactly as if they were in the world, in the body... For they cannot know otherwise than that they are the men with whom they are, for they at once come into possession of all things which belong to him... while, nevertheless, the man is left to himself, because he too is a Spirit, and so is in their society. SE 1939, Explained.
That the permissions of evils from Spirits are represented by a remission of their endeavour.
For Spirits cannot know what Angels think unless it is communicated to them.
That it is dangerous for Heaven to be opened into any Spirit...
On a certain Spirit who desired to come into Heaven. SE 2049.
As a Spirit can speak in a man, and does not know that he is not the man, he (must suppose) that he has the memory of sensuous things...
That the situation where Spirits appear is only apparent.
How good is turned into evil by Spirits.

On the effect of music and singing on Spirits. - It has twice happened that I heard music in the street, which so soothed the Spirits that they (supposed) they were in Heaven... They are so changed by it that they are scarcely the same. I therefore joked with them, saying it was no wonder the evil Spirit of Saul was so changed... They said they were in such a state that they could now neither think nor do anything evil... The Angels were also gladdened, but only when I paid less attention to it, so that I did not mingle the gladness of the Spirits as communicated to me... SE 2090. SE 2108. SE 2231. SE 2403.
On the difference in general between the state of men and that of Spirits.
It is very common for Spirits to speak through other Spirits...
On the more subtle Spirits.
On the sphere of the Spirits round about man.
Spirits are compelled to speak contrary to what they think. (See Speak.)

When many Spirits concur in any speech, they know each other distinctly; but the Spirit through whom they speak thinks that he alone speaks; and, to convince him, the nearest Spirits showed themselves, who also think that they speak from themselves; and then others, more remote, showed themselves; and so on. SE 2966. SE 2969. SE 3495 (more fully). SE 4041.
That Spirits could recognize themselves from my face as seen in a mirror. SE 2205.
That all languages derive their origin from the speech of Spirits. SE 2138. SE 2142.
While a Spirit speaks... others are speaking the same things...
That Spirits cannot do the least thing from themselves...
On Societies of Spirits.
That there are Spirits of every genus and species.
There are also genera and species of Spirits who are continually thinking about inflicting evil on man...
For the nature of Spirits is that...
That to every composite idea with man, and to the ideas of which they are composed, correspond Spirits, and Societies of Spirits.
That memory exists with Spirits.
On the exploration of Spirits and Souls.
That when Spirits manifest themselves they are wont to vary their faces, and yet to retain their own.
On the things which restrain the indecencies of Spirits.
That merely from the faculty of reflecting of Spirits and Angels, it may be evident that they are only organic powers.
That Spirits fly to one like an eagle...
I have spoken to Spirits by ideas alone. (Continued. See Speak.)
On the wisdom of Spirits, especially of Angels.
On the action of Spirits into the prophets.
Spirits who were possessing my body...
That there is no need to revere any Spirit.
The state of Spirits is such that they are not allowed to act from license, or free will.
The thoughts of Spirits are excited and disturbed by the disturbance of wakefulness, and therefore the perception is not so subtle then as on first awaking.
Every Spirit supposes that he can act according to his own phantasy.
Such is the state of the Spiritual World that if a single Spirit thinks otherwise than in order, his neighbours are at once disturbed...
It is the spirit in the body which lives...

When the Lord concedes it, Spirits are at once present, even if 10,000 miles distant... sometimes so near that they appear close to the ear, to the head, and also within the man. The same happens if they are in the most distant planet. SE 2333, Described.
Spirits appear in a fixed quarter according to their quality. Explained.
From the least idea of a man, the Angels know what Spirits are near.
The life which is felt in the body is that of the spirit, and therefore Spirits take it with them... SE 2367:2. SE 2386.
On the situation of Spirits relatively to the body.
That Spirits are in a place.
As a Spirit is substance, and, in fact, a subtle organic one, which is the subject of thought, a Spirit speaks... in a living and clear voice.
Therefore animals have no need to have any Spirit with them.
When there are no Spirits near a man, still there is influx from some Societies... A man who is I not in order cannot be without Spirits adjoined to him...
That the Spirits who are far away hear and perceive more exquisitely...
On the sense of touches with Spirits.
For Angels cannot inflow manifestly into a man's thought except through subordinate or mediate Spirits...
On the manifest operations of Spirits.
Spirits in the body, or Spirits separated from the body, are real substances, and are such substances in man as are conjoined with the material things of his body...
Why Spirits do not manifest themselves before men, and instruct them about the existence and quality of Spirits. Explained.
(Men are much more left to themselves than Spirits are.)
(Some Spirits always act in the persons of others.)
Now this Spirit speaks, now that, at various distances. Explained.
(Bodily insanity as caused by Spirits.)
Spirits apprehend these things much better than men.
Spirits are permitted to lead, persuade, and induce cupidity on those who trust in themselves and their own prudence. SE 2430. (Compare SE 2431, SE 2432.)
Distant Spirits hear better when I think tacitly.
That Spirits also sleep.
That my representations are seen by Spirits as it were alive.
Spirits seem to themselves to inhabit well-furnished houses... according to the genius of each one; and thus are bent to good...
Some Spirits do not want such things, but money. I told them that they do not need to buy anything there. Explained. SE 2449.
Certain from the families of Spirits thought...
The Spirits around man are such that as soon as any truth comes forth... they feel a repugnance.
They take with them there a high spirit (and want to be greater than others).
On the interior thought of Spirits.
They thus become interior Spirits.
On interior Spirits. SE 2565, Explained. SE 2577, Explained.
The difference between exterior and interior Spirits.
After some delay. Spirits are brought by the Lord into this interior state, as it were through sleep...
Spirits have often wondered that they were in the other life...

If men were in faith in the Lord, Heaven could be thus opened to them... almost as in me, and thus there would be an intercourse of Souls, Spirits, and Angels with men in the world... so that Spirits would know what is going on in the world, and men what is going on in Heaven. Thus they would live together, both ways. (It has been ordained by the Lord from eternity that there should be such an intercourse. SE 2542.)

I told the Spirits that they are not near me, although they seem to be... so near as to touch me... It is a most certain experience that they cannot be here, but sometimes 10, 100, 1000, 3000 miles distant... But the Spirits did not want to believe it... See SE 2887.
The Spirits said they do not know they have such superior faculties...
et seq. Spirits thrown down upon me, having been ejected from the society of Angels for being in a false idea.
That Spirits perceive quite fully the thoughts of man.
That Spirits, too, are at once carried into doing evil when the reins are slackened.

The Spirits (of the interior sphere) do indeed inflow into the thoughts of man, but do not perceive them; but only his intentions; and therefore when such (evil) intentions are absent, they cannot understand; and then good Spirits take them up, who are also interior Spirits...
These interior Spirits cannot be where there are good interior Spirits, just as they cannot be together in this world. Explained.
The Spirits in the interior sphere use the Spirits in the exterior sphere...

In the life of the body, although the Spirits are distinct, they appear to them to be a one... (and thus) they put on the man himself, because such Spirits are with him as suppose themselves to be the man.
That there is a great multitude of Spirits who take delight in inflicting injury on others.
That Spirits know from reflection that they are present.
How the first man existed without Spirits and Angels.
So with Spirits: although myriads concur to one idea, or word, each one supposes that he alone does it.

That Spirits who are of the same genus and species can be induced to believe that they are the same... And they induce other Spirits to believe they are the same... Such Spirits have been with me, and have wanted to persuade me, because they themselves were persuaded, that they were those same persons. SE 2860.

Therefore let those to whom it is granted to speak with Spirits beware of believing that they are those whom they say they are... for those who are like in genus and species... conduct themselves in the same way... (Moreover) such Spirits are in general associated with those who are like him, and, while with him, they know no otherwise than that they are the same. SE 2860.
An idea of interior Spirits is inexpressible; yet is intelligible to those who are separated from the world while they live in the body...
The speech, ideas, and felicities (of the Angels) are the continual beginnings of those of the interior Spirits; and, through this, of those of the lower Spirits, or of men.
Spirits who are wizards and witches: they spoke with others as if it were I.
They are proud of being subtle, and within the sphere of speech... in which are the interior Spirits...
But a Spirit cannot be dissolved and perish.
So that no Spirit may lose anything of what belongs to his natural mind and memory.
On the speech of the Spirits of the interior sphere.
Spirits who can induce others to believe whatever they like.
Although Spirits do not see natural objects, a certain sense comes from them to them. Explained.
A Spirit who had committed a crime, and caused the surrounding Spirits to believe themselves guilty of it.
Such persuasions have the effect that they cannot be with other Spirits.
How the speech of man is ruled through Spirits.
On the quality of the Spirits who at this day come from the world.
Such need more Spirits; those who are led according to order, fewer.
The operations of the internal viscera do not need the immediate aid of Spirits, because they are according to order.
That Spirits see all the thoughts of man, and what he has thought, and his intentions, and yet do not know that they are not the men. SE 3351:end.

Every Spirit takes out of the memory that which belongs to his own nature; and thus man is rent, suffers, ... just as unclean Spirits have seen things I have not seen myself, and have directed my eyes to filthy things... of which I must have remained wholly ignorant, unless such Spirits had known, felt, and thus seen them. The reason is, that they remove, and thus do not see, all things which do not accord with their unclean delights.
On traveller Spirits, whom other Spirits flee from: they make a sound as of little bells. SE 2972.
Persecution by interior Spirits...
That Spirits are found and affected by my looks.
On the other hand, Spirits, by their looks into me, take out of my memory...
On the bodies of Spirits.
The Spirits associated with man. SE 2926.
Spirits appropriate all the knowledges of man... Whatever a man is skilled in, the Spirits possess as their own. Example(s). SE 2928.
These stationary Spirits kept me half way between sleep and waking... SE 2931:end.
These Spirits supposed they were living in the body.
That Spirits cannot assail persuasions with man; they are as it were in the like persuasion...
That some Spirits do not at once put on the memory of man.
That the interior Spirits have a subtle perception...
When permitted, Spirits can, unknown to me, take many things from my memory.
With what difficulty man can be persuaded that he is ruled through Spirits.
That Spirits converse together exactly as men do.

When I was in a shop, the Spirits infused a desire that I should buy this or That... which I did not perceive; for, as is my wont in company, I was devoid of reflection upon Spirits. It was then given to the Spirits to reflect upon their state, in that they had caused me to buy (something) and change it; and they said that it was exactly as if they had done it... So that Spirits have a life with men exactly as if they were the man...
That Spirits have no power, and yet their life is happy.
It has often happened that when anyone has spoken to me. Spirits have spoken (and laughed) through me. Described.
That the style of my writing is varied according to the Spirits associated with me.
On the bonds in which Spirits are held.
That Spirits do not speak from themselves. SE 2969. (See SE 2100.)
How and wherefore Spirits suppose that they think from themselves, and are not kept in bonds.
That if Spirits enjoyed the corporeal memory, they could not be in a spiritual state.
On Spirits who want to be believed to be the Lord.
That Spirits have no life unless they are allowed the things they desire.
That some Spirits exceedingly desire to be men, and to occupy their bodies.
How the influx of Spirits takes place into man.

Man is the ultimate of order... and all ideas, even those of Spirits, are terminated in man's memory... A Spirit cannot but think that his ideas begin in himself... when yet his ideas are in the ideas of the man in which they are terminated, as may be evident from the fact that they appropriate to themselves each and all things of the man...
Each kind of Spirit seizes in an idea that which accords with themselves...

a. The more that ideas are closed by man... the less can Spirits infuse into him evils in addition to what he has already acquired. But with him who is in faith, the less his ideas are determined to one thing, the better it is. Explained.
In speech with Spirits the idea in a word is most exquisitely observed. Example(s).
On the true speech of Spirits.
On some Spirits who supposed it to be a phantasy that I have conversed with Spirits, and that there are any Spirits. SE 3057.
The effect on Spirits of the phantasies of others. Described.
a. How dangerous it is for any learned person who is imbued with phantasies to speak with Spirits.
That the quality of a Spirit may be Known from a single word.
That one Spirit is led by another into almost the like thoughts.
Spirits suppose they can carry off the things they see. Example(s).
(Evil Spirits, although shown that they are Spirits, at once forget it; but good Spirits have reflection given them, so that they continue to know it.) SE 3102, Example(s).

The first cause why a Spirit supposes himself to be a man, is that no reflection is given him while he is with a man who does not speak to him, or answer him; for speaking with a Spirit is conjoined with their reflecting upon him who speaks; thus that they are not man, but separate from man, and thus Spirits.

(Another reason) is that the Spirit puts on the man's memory, thus he puts on the man... But they do not possess the interior memory; this is possessed by the Angels who rule the Spirits who are below... When a man reaches the point that his interior memory is ruled by the interior Spirits the man can live no longer.
Spirits suppose that they could have been led differently and thus have become better...
That the bodies of Spirits are beheld in a fixed attitude as well as in a fixed place.
On speech with Spirits. (See Speak.)
Therefore Spirits are in a more perfect state...
That Spirits speak those things which others think interiorly.
